investigations.name: gg-01-differential-adhesion-sorting
investigations.title: Differential-adhesion cell sorting (Fig 12)
investigations.objective:
Under the Glazier & Graner (1993) Fig-12 sorting energies (J_ll=14, J_dd=2, J_ld=11,
J_lM=J_dM=16, T=10; gamma_ld=+3), does the wrapped Artistoo CPM sort a mixed two-type aggregate —
the cohesive dark type retreating to the interior, engulfed by a light monolayer — so that the
heterotypic boundary fraction falls while cells stay intact?
investigations.claim:
pbg-artistoo reproduces Fig-12 sorting: heterotypic fraction falls 0.479 -> 0.379 (-21%, mean of
3 seeds) with connectedness 0.998 — clean differential-adhesion engulfment, no motility.

investigations.name: gg-02-sign-and-temperature-controls
investigations.title: Sign and temperature controls (Fig 7 & Fig 9)
investigations.objective:
Are the two adversarial controls reproduced? (1) With NEGATIVE heterotypic tension (checkerboard,
Fig 7: gamma_ld=-3) the aggregate should intercalate and the heterotypic fraction should RISE —
the opposite of sorting. (2) At HIGH temperature (Fig 9: sorting energies at T=40) thermal
fluctuations should overwhelm the tension barriers and the aggregate should MIX rather than sort
cleanly. Do these behave as the paper predicts, and does the heterotypic-fraction order parameter
suffice to distinguish them from sorting?
